tips.title: Knife Sharpening for Scale Model Tools
tips.text: Use a whetstone with a grit of at least 6000 to sharpen scale model knives. Apply a small amount of water to the stone and sharpen in a push-pull motion, maintaining a 20-degree angle between the blade and the stone.
